map.URL 编码长度估算 使用指南: URL Encoded Length Estimation — User Guide
map.输入可能含中文、空格或符号的 URL 字符串，工具按 RFC 3986 估算编码: Enter a URL string that may contain Chinese, spaces or symbols, and the tool estimates the encoded length per RFC 3986 (only alphanumerics and -_.~ are safe), helping control request-line length.
map.URL 编码将每个非安全字符转为 %XX（3 字符）编码长度 = 安全字符数 +: URL encoding turns each unsafe character into %XX (3 characters); encoded length = number of safe characters + 3 × number of characters needing encoding
map.请求行预算：长参数含中文经百分号编码后显著变长，需预估是否超服务器限制。: Request-line budget: long parameters with Chinese get much longer after percent-encoding, so estimate whether server limits are exceeded.
map.链接生成：短链/分享链接中嵌入中文参数的长度规划。: Link generation: length planning for Chinese parameters embedded in short/share links.
map.网关限制核对：避免编码后 URL 超代理/浏览器长度上限。: Gateway limit checks: avoid the encoded URL exceeding proxy/browser length limits.
map.：你好 各 3 字节 UTF-8 → 每字节 %XX 共 9 字符，整体编码后明: : each Chinese character is 3 UTF-8 bytes → each byte becomes %XX, 9 characters total, so the encoded form is noticeably longer than the original.
map.RFC 3986 中 A-Za-z0-9 与 -_.~ 安全，其余（含中文/空格: In RFC 3986, A-Za-z0-9 and -_.~ are safe; everything else (including Chinese and spaces) becomes %XX.
map.中文为何变这么长？: Why does Chinese get so long?
map.中文 UTF-8 每字 3 字节，每字节编码为 %XX（3 字符），故 1 中文: Each Chinese character is 3 UTF-8 bytes, each byte encodes to %XX (3 characters), so one Chinese character ≈ 9 characters.
map.与 URL 编码空间占比区别？: Difference from URL encoding space ratio?
map.本工具估绝对长度，另一工具估相对膨胀比例。: This tool estimates absolute length, the other estimates relative bloat ratio.
